value.rationale: Catmull-Rom overshoot is a documented stability concern and motivates monotonicity filters. The exact \(2/27\) standard defect supplies a sharp worst-case scale rather than a qualitative warning, while the full \(4\sigma/27\) law quantifies the tradeoff with cardinal tension. Exact equality cases and a strictly increasing positive counterexample make the result directly usable for regression testing and safeguard design.
